first.rationale: The immediate threat is competitive price-based churn of SMB accounts. Memory_73 directly validates promotional pricing as effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with acquisition and revenue lift. Memory_31 shows onboarding simplification works but is a weaker lever against active competitive displacement. The 4% onboarding completion decline and 6% activation decline are concerning signals, but memory_86 and memory_91 suggest these are separate levers best tested after defending against the acute competitive threat. Promotional pricing targets the acute problem immediately while preserving the ability to test activation and onboarding improvements once competitive pressure stabilizes. Verification of memory_73 and memory_31 will confirm the magnitude of prior effect sizes and whether SMB pricing conditions have shifted. This approach prioritizes sustainable revenue (defending margin and LTV) over vanity activation metrics. Standard experiment scale allows real signal while managing downside risk to enterprise segment.
